thread:
jordan: heads-up: seeing a weird reshuffle in ap-southeast1 where PV-affinity + rack-aware scoring is causing repeated evictions for gpu-model instances. filing here.
priya: which cluster/az? any logs?
jordan: ap-southeast1-a and -b, non-prod. started after we enabled "rackPreferLocal" scoring in scheduler config last night. tiny example below.
rick: paste the pod events and node status pls
jordan: ```
$ kubectl describe pod gpu-model-xy -n infra
Events:
  10:30:12   Scheduled   default-scheduler   Successfully assigned infra/gpu-model-xy to gpu-node-12
  10:30:25   Preempted   kube-scheduler   Preempted by higher priority pod
  10:30:26   Scheduled   default-scheduler   Assigned to gpu-node-27
  10:30:40   Preempted   kube-scheduler   Preempted by higher priority pod
```
priya: why preempted? any PVC binding failures or topology conflicts?
jordan: PVC is Bound (local-ssd backed) and has nodeAffinity for rack=R12. scheduler tried to honor rack affinity but scoring favored packing on nodes with matching rack-labels causing higher-priority pods to steal slots. repeated because autoscaler removes underutilized nodes between reschedules.
callout-bot: alert: node gpu-node-12 kernel oom-killer events spike at 10:29 UTC.
rick: so interplay: PV nodeAffinity wants rack R12 -> scheduler prefers those nodes -> tight packing -> preemption of low-priority pods -> autoscaler scale-down -> capacity churn -> repeat.
priya: can we confirm PV nodeAffinity vs topologySpread? also which controller created those PVCs?
jordan: PVCs created by statefulset modelpool-v1. They set volumeBindingMode: Immediate (ugh). We should use WaitForFirstConsumer for local volumes.
ops-bot: autoscaler: ap-southeast1-a scaled down -8 nodes at 10:32:01 UTC (policy: underutilized).
priya: immediate fixes: 1) pause scale-down in the overlay for 20m, 2) patch StatefulSet to update storageClass to WaitForFirstConsumer for new replicas, 3) add a short scheduler preemption-backoff for pods with pvc nodeAffinity.
jordan: will apply pause and roll storage change for staging first.
rick: for quick mitigation we can mark nodes with label rack=R12 as protected (taint/NoSchedule?) — but that might reduce capacity. better: add a soft penalty in scoring for nodes with recent preemptions.
jordan: I pushed a hotfix to scheduler-config to bump preemptionBackoffSeconds=15 for now.
priya: PR? paste diff
jordan: ```
patch: scheduler-configmap: set preemptionBackoffSeconds: "15"
kubectl apply -f scheduler-configmap.yaml && rollout restart deployment/kube-scheduler -n kube-system
```
callout-bot: action: ConfigMap applied at 10:35:12 UTC. scheduler pods restarting (2/3 ready).
ops-bot: autoscaler: scale-down paused for overlay-ap-southeast until 10:55 UTC.
rick: longer term: 1) migrate local PVs to WaitForFirstConsumer + zonal topology, 2) prefer node stability score in scheduler and penalize nodes with >=2 preempts in last 5m, 3) consider making rackPreferLocal a soft weight not strict tie-break.
priya: cost/impact: temporary extra nodes ~ +9 nodes for 20m -> small $$ but we avoid churn. capture in postmortem.
jordan: logging shows reschedule-rate dropped from 180/min to 22/min after patch. scheduler CPU back to 34%.
priya: good. will open an RFC for storageClass migration plan and scheduler scoring changes. assign owners? jordan -> storage change plan, rick -> scheduler scoring heuristics.
jordan: will follow up with timeline and test scenarios (simulate local-pvc + rack labels). thanks all :rocket:
